Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, four women in a single row.

A photograph of FOUR women standing side by side in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 4 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult French woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, a still, steady expression, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Turkish İznik tile — a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems, wide cobalt-and-coral bands following every deep crease, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the flagstones beside her feet.
